items: Migration Plan — map each legacy component to one of the 7R strategies; sequence using the Strangler Fig pattern; define cutover and rollback.
Cost & Risk Assessment — TCO model, savings thesis, top-10 risks with likelihood/impact/mitigation.

Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) — at least 6 ADRs for pivotal choices (cloud provider, decomposition strategy, data stores, event backbone, AI approach, multi-region topology). Each ADR must state context, decision, alternatives considered, and consequences.
The SAD Document — the integrated deliverable (structure below) that ties 1–5 together.
Logical & Physical Architecture — with diagrams. Logical: domains, bounded contexts, data flows. Physical: concrete services, clusters, regions, networks.
Resilience & Data Strategy — failure modes, circuit breakers, bulkheads, idempotency; data partitioning, replication, consistency, GDPR handling.
